recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Re-adding a direct Provenance.entity identifier choice would conflict with later Published simplification decisions; future changes should be handled as a new Security/MnM decision about Reference.identifier semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-12503 was a Published Security work group change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for DSTU2, asking Provenance.entity.reference to support non-FHIR content; the recorded resolution was to add an Identifier element to entity.
initial_application: Commit 8058a0886c12cc7a61a61db3edae51be5e5698ef explicitly names GF#12503 and changed Provenance.entity.reference to Provenance.entity.what[x] with uri, Reference(Any), and Identifier choices, plus example updates using whatIdentifier.
additional_context: FHIR-13694 clarified Reference.identifier logical references, FHIR-13570 tied Provenance.entity.what guidance to that clarification, and FHIR-15659 explicitly found Provenance whatIdentifier/whatReference redundant after logical references. Commit 6c0a0563b3ac6a188b713f2f1a04ff26229100cf implemented the simplification, and FHIR-49893 later corrected the current Provenance.entity.what comment to say what.identifier.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. Current active Provenance source defines Provenance.entity.what as Reference(Resource) and directs non-resource entities to what.identifier; current Reference datatype source and narrative define Reference.identifier as the logical-reference mechanism, including the case where no FHIR representation exists for a Reference(Any) target.

related_jiras.note: Clarified that Reference.identifier is the logical-reference mechanism used when no FHIR instance is exposed.
Clarified how Provenance.entity.whatUri and whatIdentifier should relate to Reference.identifier before later simplification.
Removed redundant Provenance whatIdentifier/whatReference choices after logical references made a separate Identifier element unnecessary.
The implementation commit for the simplification also applied AuditEvent reference/identifier cleanup.
Corrected the current Provenance.entity.what comment from whatIdentity to what.identifier.

evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope resource directs non-resource/non-FHIR identifiers through Reference.identifier.

evidence_items.learned: Current Reference semantics preserve the capability FHIR-12503 sought without a separate Provenance Identifier choice.
